Titles.jpn: 映画 えんとつ町のプペル 〜約束の時計台〜

Summaries.eng: After losing his friend Poupelle, young Lubicchi wanders into a mysterious realm where a clock in a tower is frozen at 11:59. To return home, he must restart it – and find the courage to believe again.

Aliases: Entotsumachi no Poupelle - Yakusoku no Tokeidai
Entotsu Machi no Poupelle 2 : Yakusoku no Tokei-dai
Poupelle of Chimney Town ~The Promised Clock Tower~
